meta.title: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials centres in New Sangvi and Wakad
meta.description: Two JEE coaching centres in Pimpri-Chinchwad: the head office in New Sangvi and a branch in Wakad. Addresses, hours and directions.

h1: Our centres in New Sangvi and Wakad
intro: We teach JEE at two centres in Pimpri-Chinchwad. The head office in {{fact:org.founded#place}} is where D-SAP Ghule Tutorials started in {{fact:org.founded#year}}. The branch in Wakad is closer for families from Hinjewadi, Balewadi and Kalewadi.

sections.heading: Visit a centre
body: Each centre page has the address, a map link, photos and the classes that run there.

sections.heading: What you will find there

body.text: Classrooms have AI-powered digital boards. JEE classes run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, with at most {{fact:batch.size}} students in a batch.

body: {{fact:centre.sangvi.library}} is at the head office, for students who want a quiet place to study.
